text:
jason: Auditor asked for a consolidated evidence packet for the Feb 12 API incident that affected auth and caused a billing spike. They want timeline, logs, KMS/HSM access records, and the post-incident RCA within 48h. Sharing the auditor note here.
katie: ack. I'm pulling incident ticket and matrix. Incident id is INC-20250212-17. Customers reported 503s + token errors around 03:14 UTC, billing anomalies at ~03:20 UTC.
sre_ops: repro summary: a transient cache invalidation triggered retry storms. Steps to repro (internal):
```
1) set X-Auth-Cache: miss
2) flood /v1/generate with 20RPS with 2s timeout
3) observe 503s and repeated auth validation calls
```
sre_ops: attaching relevant logs snippet (sanitized) — see s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/INC-20250212-17/ (I can export a zip if auditor needs it).
ben: KMS/HSM notes: CMEK key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 was in use for object encryption. No key rotation occurred during the incident window. HSM access logs id: hsm-log-9987 show only readonly ops between 02:50-04:00 UTC. I can export HSM audit bundle.
auditor_bot: Please provide: (1) export of the S3 audit logs for path above, (2) KMS key usage report for the key ARN during 02:00-05:00 UTC, (3) HSM audit bundle and signer records, (4) incident ticket + comms timeline, (5) billing invoice & spike trace (invoice INV-9923).
maria: we've prepared an evidence bundle draft at https://internal.redwood.com/evidence/packets/EP-2025-02-12-1 (access controlled). Bundle currently includes: incident ticket INC-20250212-17, sanitized app logs, API gateway traces, and billing spike csv. Need KMS/HSM exports and legal approval for HSM logs before sharing externally.
sean: retention & controls note: audit logs retention policy is 2 years for API gateway, 3 years for billing, and 7 years for HSM audit trails per our config. Export commands for auditor:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit/logs/INC-20250212-17.log.gz .
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id abcd-ef01
```
katie: question for ben: do we have signed key rotation proofs or attestations for that key? Auditor asked for proof of rotation schedule + last rotation artifact.
ben: we have rotation records: rotation-ticket RT-20241010-9, and rotation-proof file rotation-proof-20241010.sig stored in KMS-ops vault. Last rotation was Oct 10 2024; not during this incident. Will package signed attestation.
auditor_bot: Clarify whether any customer data was exfiltrated or decrypted outside of controls. Also request chain-of-custody for exported logs.
jason: quick answers for auditor to avoid delay: (1) No evidence of decryption outside of our env. (2) Billing spike due to retries causing token refresh churn — costs are grossed up in INV-9923; finance prepping a credit memo draft. (3) We will provide HSM bundle after Legal signs the DPA appendix.
maria: next steps — Ben to export KMS key usage CSV and HSM bundle by EOD UTC. SRE to produce sanitized logs and step-by-step repro with knob settings. Compliance will assemble final ZIP and share secure link. Target share time: 2025-02-14 16:00 UTC. If any blocker, call a quick huddle.
sean: added note: please include exact log lines for the auth header errors: "knox: missing subject" and the gateway 503 backtrace id.
katie: will also add canary eval showing rate of retries pre/post mitigation.
jason: thanks team. auditor expects receipt and initial Q&A response within 48h of this thread. I'll ping if they come back with follow-ups. :thumbsup:
